study.question: With correctly aligned actions retained in direct pooling and original feedback masks frozen, do residual history summaries need within-block event-aligned actions beyond block action composition, and does the effect interact with task-specific versus shared residual readout?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the incumbent click AUC is 0.66675355 versus DIN 0.65554408, but its auxiliary AUCs are lower than DIN. Token removal reaches 0.64119001 and the context replacement 0.64142969; both are preliminary, conditional on retained masks. The scorer-only trajectory reaches 0.65417413 while values-only reaches 0.66624443, so scorer action is not required to retain most click quality in this seed. Pool-only task/shared reaches 0.66076439/0.66004844, summary-only reaches 0.65996485/0.65207862. Match-only and ordinal-only summary trajectories underperform the all-summary trajectory; restoring pool actions brings match/ordinal task to 0.66348055/0.66375366 and shared to 0.66243442/0.66181604. The latest quartet retains all nominal parameters yet still trails all-summary values-only controls 0.66624443/0.66474880, and its auxiliary outcomes differ by summary family. This suggests a consequential uncertainty about event-specific summary content rather than merely having extra action coordinates. Working hypothesis: block action composition is insufficient; action-to-item/local-position association in residual summaries supplies conditional predictive information, with task readout changing its utility. The historical results motivate this test but do not prove the hypothesis, interaction, or a new contribution.

Inherit target-conditioned unnormalized local activation and Dice through the local implementation. This is a four-task offline adaptation plus conditional residual-summary intervention, not exact DIN reproduction or a new attention architecture. The paper discusses sequence noise; that external result does not predict this intervention.

Here masks stay fixed and no hub projection, broadcast or stacked token network is adopted. Original-author equivalence, transfer and priority remain unverified.

Only the authorized nine-line author README was read: its behavior fields lack item IDs. Our supplied histories are advertisement exposures with item/category/brand fields. No DMR mechanism equivalence or effectiveness transfer is claimed; publisher full paper remains unavailable.

study.proposed_difference: The materialized r0028 source becomes a fresh 2x2 quartet with summary_action_group=all in every cell and two selectors only: summary_action_alignment aligned/rotated and residual_routing task/shared. The summary-only helper reshapes actions into10 blocks of10, packs original positions by valid-event rank, uses a cyclic shift floor(valid_count/2) or0, gathers action embeddings, and leaves invalid positions and item coordinates unchanged. The same embedding lookup still feeds unmodified scorer/compression/direct-pool paths. Original masks are never altered. Block-local action multisets and sums survive, so coarse block-constant action moments are invariant algebraically; match and local-position summary actions may change. At a common state, unchanged direct pools, item summaries and scorer populations are controls. Fresh aligned controls avoid treating old endpoint receipts as exact bridges without verification. All cells retain all existing learned modules; no new learned state or RNG. The submitted rotated/task candidate is an attribution probe rather than a promised improvement. This study asserts no architectural novelty or primary-source priority. The four files plus proposal are the reproducible outputs; the host consumes each literal CONFIG through the runtime candidate API.
predictions: Define L_task=AUC(summary_align_task)-AUC(summary_rotate_task) and L_shared=AUC(summary_align_shared)-AUC(summary_rotate_shared), using paired frozen training and full-population validation. Conditional alignment utility predicts positive L in at least the task readout; the stronger task-conditioning hypothesis predicts I=L_task-L_shared>0. Report L and I as raw AUC differences with no significance claim from one seed.

Matched-state controls predict identical masks, action multisets per block, direct pools, scorer activations and item-coordinate summaries. Only local-order/match action coordinates should differ beyond measured numerical roundoff. Empty, singleton and action-homogeneous blocks provide negative perturbation controls.

Report all four AUC/Logloss values, auxiliary mean separately, total/embedding/dense parameters, examples processed, allocated GPU seconds, wall/train/inference time, memory, throughput and batch p50/p95. No selection on auxiliary mean. Fresh aligned values should approximately recover old values-only results if bridge and deterministic host reproduction hold; those old results are not extra independent runs.

Report predeclared history bins empty/1-16/17-64/>64 with sample/positive/negative counts and undefined-AUC handling. If the authorized host can supply input-only diagnostics, also count changed blocks/histories and use predeclared changed-versus-unchanged history groups; no sample IDs or additional features enter Model. Other slices are exploratory. Bootstrap by user cluster only if the host already provides an authorized cluster interface; otherwise mark intervals unavailable.
falsifiers: A nonpositive L_task or lack of reproducibility weakens the task-readout alignment hypothesis. I<=0 weakens the directional interaction claim even if both L values are positive; a positive loss without a directional interaction supports only conditional alignment utility.

Any change in masks, target-action visibility, invalid-input invariance, direct-pool/scorer/item-summary values at fixed state, learned state or auxiliary gradient ownership invalidates controlled attribution and must be fixed before full training.

If most eligible blocks have repeated/homogeneous actions or rotation leaves effective local/match summaries unchanged, a null is non-diagnostic for general alignment utility. Quantify this and do not call the mechanism refuted.

If the result disappears under paired repetitions, a second composition-preserving surrogate, or later scale/optimization controls, weaken the interpretation. A single cyclic rotation does not establish a semantic mechanism.
Aligned source/optimizer bridge failures limit old-trial comparisons to descriptive observations; failure does not authorize silently changing the contract or consuming held-out feedback.
